name: Tamashin Regional/Future Co-creation Centre me:rise Tachikawa
card: A Tama co-creation hub reborn from a credit union's former head office
title: me:rise Tachikawa — a regional and future co-creation centre in the renovated former head office of Tama Shinkin Bank
lead: me:rise Tachikawa, the Tamashin Regional/Future Co-creation Centre, is in TAMA MIRAI SQUARE, about a four-minute walk from the North Exit of Tachikawa Station. It is a community hub run by Tama Shinkin Bank, opened in February 2023 by renovating the bank's former head-office building. The ground floor has reception, a café counter and a challenge space; the 2nd floor has an advice counter, private rooms, booth seats, meeting rooms and incubation rooms. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Tachikawa Station North Exit, about 4 min walk
1F: reception, café counter, challenge space, free space / 2F: advice counter, private rooms, booth seats, meeting rooms, incubation rooms (24-hour access)
February 2023 (renovated former head office of Tama Shinkin Bank)
concept: Creating the region's future together
The official website presents me:rise Tachikawa as the “Tamashin Regional/Future Co-creation Centre”, a community hub run by Tama Shinkin Bank.
Through start-up support for entrepreneurs and local companies, business support and community building, it aims to create new industries in the Tama region.
steps: Eat, take calls and talk at every seat
The free space is open seating where eating, phone calls and conversation are allowed at every seat.
Besides memberships from ¥7,800 a month, there is one-off use at ¥500 per hour.
Seats to focus, and rooms with a key
Booth seats are semi-private and suit people who want to concentrate.
Lockable private rooms can serve as a business base.
The 2nd floor has meeting rooms and web-meeting booths.
Meeting rooms can be rented for ¥1,000 per hour, with discounts for members.
With a credit union by your side
At the 2nd-floor advice counter, you can talk to bank staff about starting or running a business.
Incubation rooms have 24-hour access and are aimed at people in the early stages of starting a business.

word.title: What is a challenge space?
body: A place where you can try selling or showcasing a new product or service for a set period.
On the ground floor of me:rise Tachikawa is a challenge space that can be rented in two-week blocks.

credits: © Tama Shinkin Bank (me:rise Tachikawa official website)

name: tefu lounge Shimokitazawa
card: Zero minutes from the southwest gate of Shimokitazawa Station, a complex built around a lounge
title: tefu lounge Shimokitazawa — a workplace with a café lounge, booths and rooms in a complex right at the station
lead: tefu lounge Shimokitazawa is right outside the southwest ticket gate of Shimokitazawa Station on the Odakyu Line. The official website describes it as “a complex centred on a lounge you can use however you like — for work, study, reading, tea or conversation”. Along with the lounge, it lists booths, rooms, a studio and a cinema. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Odakyu Line Shimokitazawa Station southwest gate, 0 min walk / Keio Inokashira Line central gate, 3 min
Lounge / booths / rooms / meeting rooms / studio / cinema (as listed on the official website)
Power and Wi-Fi / meeting rooms and meeting booths / free-flow specialty coffee
concept: A lounge to use your own way

The official website describes tefu as “a sharing service for furniture, space and time” — rather than owning spaces and things and consuming their value, the idea is to share them and pass them on to the future.
It is zero minutes on foot from the southwest gate of Shimokitazawa Station. Lounge plans range from easy hourly use to monthly plans you can use as an office, plus a 24-hour add-on.
steps: The official website describes the lounge as “a café lounge you can use however you like — for work, study, reading, tea or conversation”.
There is power and Wi-Fi, and specialty coffee is free-flow.
According to the official website, the 3rd floor has a lounge area, a booth area and several meeting rooms.
Booths are individual seats available 24 hours, and meeting rooms hold up to 8.
The 4th floor has a room area for small companies and a shared terrace and kitchen.
The same building also has a studio and a cinema, so there are plenty of ways to spend time between work.

word.title: What is tefu?
body: The name of a sharing service for furniture, space and time. Its official website carries the phrase “Share.”
Through vintage-furniture sharing and space management, it aims to support “living true to yourself while sharing many kinds of value”.

name: tefu jiyugaoka
card: A vintage-furniture lounge and offices, two minutes from the South Exit of Jiyugaoka Station
title: tefu jiyugaoka — a Jiyugaoka base with a café, offices, a studio and a lounge dotted with vintage furniture
lead: tefu jiyugaoka is a two-minute walk from the South Exit of Jiyugaoka Station on the Tokyu Toyoko and Oimachi lines. It is made up of a café, lounge, offices and a studio, and the official website invites you to enjoy “rich time where work and life blend together through a stay in the lounge”. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Tokyu Toyoko & Oimachi lines Jiyugaoka Station South Exit, 2 min walk
Café & lounge 9:00–21:00 (last lounge entry 20:00) / offices 24 hours / studio 10:00–20:00
Building C: reception and café / Building A: lounge users only / Building B: office users only
concept: Time where work and life blend
The official website describes the lounge as a place to “find your favourite seat and your own way of spending time in a spacious room dotted with vintage furniture”.
The site is split into three buildings: Building C has reception and the café, Building A is for lounge users, and Building B for office users.
steps: A spacious room of vintage furniture
The café and lounge are open 9:00–21:00 (café last order 20:30, last lounge entry 20:00).
Every plan includes free café coffee, with Wi-Fi and power.
There are also meeting booths that handle online meetings.
Offices are available 24 hours. Up to 3 people can be registered for a desk and up to 4 for a booth.
The official website says that having your own special, private place within the lounge lets you enjoy the community more deeply.

word.title: What is vintage furniture?
body: Furniture from earlier eras that has gained character over many years. tefu runs a vintage-furniture sharing business.
The lounge at tefu jiyugaoka is dotted with vintage pieces, so each seat offers a different kind of comfort.

name: MOV KURAMAE
card: An eight-storey shared office run by KOKUYO in Kuramae
title: MOV KURAMAE — a Kuramae shared office drawing on KOKUYO's expertise, with a lounge and a tatami meeting room
lead: MOV KURAMAE occupies an eight-storey building in the Kuramae–Asakusabashi area. The official website describes it as “a shared office combining flexible private spaces and a variety of common spaces, drawing on KOKUYO's expertise in creating workspaces”. Shared spaces are spread across the floors, from the ground-floor café and the 2nd-floor lounge to the 8th-floor meeting rooms. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Steel-reinforced concrete, 8 floors above ground (completed 1998), total floor area 2,222.51 m²
Rooms / high booths / booths / desks / MOV LOUNGE / meeting rooms, KURA-MA, TATAMI / ground-floor café
Desk ¥33,000/month / booth from ¥43,000 / high booth from ¥78,000 / room from ¥203,000 (excl. tax)
hero_cap: Sofa seating in MOV LOUNGE on the 2nd floor
concept: Drawing on workspace expertise

The official website presents it as “a shared office in the Kuramae–Asakusabashi area combining flexible private spaces and a variety of common spaces, drawing on KOKUYO's expertise in creating workspaces”.
Members have 24-hour access with their own key card. Wi-Fi and utilities are included in the fee, and furniture is provided.
steps: An entrance open to the street
On the ground floor is the café “REFRESH STAND”.
The building is an eight-storey steel-reinforced concrete structure completed in 1998, with a monument at the ground-floor entrance.
MOV LOUNGE is a spacious lounge and dining area that tenant companies can use freely.
With sofa seating, it works for meetings and breaks.
The entrance to MOV LOUNGE on the 2nd floor
The 3rd floor has single-person booths, and the 4th and 5th floors have high booths for 1–2 people.
Booths start at ¥43,000 a month and high booths at ¥78,000 (excl. tax).
High booths on the 4th and 5th floors
Two meeting rooms with different moods
The 8th floor has “KURA-MA”, a meeting room with a counter, and “TATAMI”, a tatami meeting room.
There are also meeting rooms for up to 10 and a room for solo web meetings.

word.title: What is KURA-MA?
body: The name of a meeting room on the 8th floor of MOV KURAMAE. The official website describes it as a room with a counter and sink, a balcony and a TV.
The same floor also has the tatami meeting room “TATAMI”, so you can choose the mood of your meeting.

name: RYOZAN PARK Sugamo GRAND
card: Natural materials and art, with a professional shared kitchen
title: RYOZAN PARK Sugamo GRAND — coworking in wood, stone and art, with offices, a shared kitchen and a gallery
lead: RYOZAN PARK Sugamo GRAND is in the Grand Toho Building near JR Sugamo Station. The official website calls it “an office that stimulates the five senses and sparks interaction”. The ground floor is a coworking space, and the 3rd and 4th floors are private offices. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Shared kitchen (licensed for restaurant, confectionery and deli production) / gallery / event space / streaming studio / gym
concept: Stimulating the senses, sparking interaction
The official website describes it as a workspace “built from natural materials such as wood and stone, decorated with greenery and artworks, that stimulates ideas and creativity”.
With a professional shared kitchen and a gallery, it can be used for food-related projects, art exhibitions and much more.
steps: Single-site full-time coworking is ¥16,500 a month, available 6:00–24:00 every day.
There are two standing desks and two reclining booths, so you can change posture as you work.
There are two Framery phone booths and two meeting booths for 4, both free.
The meeting room is bookable, seats 8 and costs ¥550 per hour.
The 3rd and 4th floors are private offices.
The professional shared kitchen is licensed for restaurant, confectionery and deli production, from ¥2,200 per hour.

word.title: What is a shared kitchen?
body: A commercial kitchen that several people or businesses share in time slots. The kitchen at RYOZAN PARK Sugamo GRAND is licensed for restaurant, confectionery and deli production.
It lets you start developing and testing food products before opening a shop of your own.

name: RYOZAN PARK Otsuka GREEN
card: Designed by Akihisa Hirata, an office like a green mountain joined to a park
title: RYOZAN PARK Otsuka GREEN — offices and a lab designed by Akihisa Hirata, like a green mountain in the city
lead: RYOZAN PARK Otsuka GREEN is in Urban Green in Minami-Otsuka. The official website calls it “an office that supports sustainable activities” and notes that the office was designed by the architect Akihisa Hirata. The 2nd floor has private offices and fixed desks; the 3rd floor has private offices and a lab. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: 2F private offices and fixed desks / 3F private offices and lab
Shared space (up to 5) / Laboratory (meeting room) / terrace / rooftop
concept: A lush green mountain in the city
The official website describes “a bold, green-filled design that connects with the park in front, like a lush green mountain in the middle of the city”.
Beyond offices, it has a meeting room that doubles as a laboratory and shared spaces indoors and out, supporting challenges to “give shape to your aspirations”.
steps: The shared space holds up to 5 and is free to use.
There are also outdoor desks and meeting spots surrounded by greenery, and members can use the terrace and rooftop.
Fixed desks are available 24 hours, 365 days, for ¥38,500 a month.
Fixed-desk members can also use the coworking space on the 6th floor of OTSUKA, five minutes' walk away.
A meeting room with a sink and workbench
There are facilities specialised for environmental and agricultural work, including a lab with a sink and workbench.
Another feature is the chance to build connections with the park in front, local government and people in primary industries.

word.title: Who is Akihisa Hirata?
body: The architect who designed the office at RYOZAN PARK Otsuka GREEN. The official website describes it as “office design by architect Akihisa Hirata”.
According to the official website, the building connects with the park in front and is designed like “a lush green mountain in the middle of the city”.

credits: Akihisa Hirata (as stated on the official website)

name: H¹T Otemachi
card: One minute from Exit B2a of Otemachi Station, with 45 private rooms on the 20th and 21st floors
title: H¹T Otemachi — a corporate shared office with 45 single-person rooms on the 20th and 21st floors of the Taisei Otemachi Building
lead: H¹T Otemachi, run by Nomura Real Estate, is on the 20th and 21st floors of the Taisei Otemachi Building (formerly the Otemachi Nomura Building), a one-minute walk from Exit B2a of Otemachi Station on the Tokyo Metro Tozai Line and Toei Mita Line. H¹T is a shared office for companies with no initial or base fee. Spread over two floors, this site has 45 single-person rooms, making it one of the larger H¹T locations. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Weekdays 7:30–22:00 / Sat 8:00–18:00 / closed Sundays and holidays
Open space for 12 / 8 single boxes, 1 box for 4 / 45 single rooms / meeting rooms: 2 for 6, 2 for 10
Tozai & Mita lines Otemachi Station Exit B2a, 1 min walk / Marunouchi, Hanzomon & Chiyoda lines Otemachi Station Exit A5, 2 min
concept: A large site across two high floors
H¹T Otemachi spans the 20th and 21st floors of the Taisei Otemachi Building. With 45 single-person rooms and eight single-person boxes, it has a lot of seats for working alone.

There is one box for 4, and two meeting rooms each for 6 and for 10. The official website says it can be used for many purposes: remote work, a base for sales staff, seminars, training and interviews.
steps: One minute from the station exit, you can be at a seat moments after arriving.
Eight for one, one for four
There are eight single-person boxes and one box for four.
They suit short tasks or small-group discussions.
With a door to close, they work well on days full of online meetings.
There are two meeting rooms for 6 and two for 10.
With rooms for 10, it can also handle training and internal meetings.

word.title: What is a satellite shared office?
body: A workplace away from head office that several companies use together.
H¹T is run by Nomura Real Estate: companies become members, and their employees use sites while out or near home.

credits: H¹T (Nomura Real Estate Development Co., Ltd.)

name: H¹T Jimbocho
card: 14 seats and 4 meeting rooms on the 5th floor, one minute from Exit A7 of Jimbocho Station
title: H¹T Jimbocho — a corporate shared office on the 5th floor of the Ichigo Jimbocho Building, one minute from Jimbocho Station
lead: H¹T Jimbocho, run by Nomura Real Estate, is on the 5th floor of the Ichigo Jimbocho Building, a one-minute walk from Exit A7 of Jimbocho Station on the Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line and Toei Shinjuku and Mita lines. The official website describes it as “a corporate shared office one minute from Jimbocho Station, with no initial or base fee”. It is a weekday-only site, open from 8:00 to 21:00. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Open space for 14 / 1 single box / 6 single rooms / meeting rooms: 2 for 2, 1 for 4, 1 for 8
Hanzomon, Shinjuku & Mita lines Jimbocho Station Exit A7, 1 min walk
concept: A small site with a roomier open space
H¹T Jimbocho puts the emphasis on shared seating, with an open space for 14 compared with six single-person rooms.
There are four meeting rooms in all: two for 2, and one each for 4 and 8. Small as it is, you can still pick a room by headcount.
steps: One minute from Exit A7 of Jimbocho Station, it is easy to drop in before or after a meeting.
There is one single-person box and six single-person rooms.
Calls and online meetings can be taken in a room without worrying about those around you.
The meeting rooms are two for 2, one for 4 and one for 8.
From interviews to small meetings, everything can be handled on the same floor.

word.title: What is Jimbocho?
body: A neighbourhood centred on Kanda-Jimbocho in Chiyoda City, known for its many second-hand bookshops and publishers.
H¹T Jimbocho is on the 5th floor of the Ichigo Jimbocho Building, a one-minute walk from Exit A7 of Jimbocho Station.

credits: H¹T (Nomura Real Estate Development Co., Ltd.)

name: H¹T Ginza
card: One minute from Exit A7 of Ginza Station, open 7:00–22:00 every day
title: H¹T Ginza — a corporate shared office on the 4th floor of the Ginza Center Building, one minute from Ginza Station and open weekends and holidays
lead: H¹T Ginza, run by Nomura Real Estate, is on the 4th floor of the Ginza Center Building, a one-minute walk from Exit A7 of Ginza Station on the Tokyo Metro Ginza, Marunouchi and Hibiya lines. The official website describes it as “a corporate shared office one minute from Ginza Station, with no initial or base fee”. It keeps the same hours, 7:00 to 22:00, on weekdays, weekends and holidays. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Open space for 18 / 3 single boxes / 11 single rooms / meeting rooms: 1 each for 2, 6, 7 and 8
Ginza, Marunouchi & Hibiya lines Ginza Station Exit A7, 1 min walk
concept: A Ginza site with the same hours at weekends
H¹T Ginza is open 7:00–22:00 on weekdays, weekends and holidays alike. With hours that never change by day, it is easy to plan around.

The open space is generous at 18 seats, with three single-person boxes, eleven single-person rooms and four meeting rooms for 2 to 8. The official website says it can be used for remote work, as a base for sales staff and for interviews.
steps: One minute from Exit A7 of Ginza Station, you can drop in between shopping or business meetings.
There are three single-person boxes and eleven single-person rooms.
They suit focused work and online meetings.
There is one meeting room each for 2, 6, 7 and 8 people.
They work for meetings with clients in Ginza and team discussions.

word.title: What is H¹T?
body: A satellite shared office for companies run by Nomura Real Estate. The official website states there is no initial fee and no base fee.
The Ginza site is on the 4th floor of the Ginza Center Building.

credits: H¹T (Nomura Real Estate Development Co., Ltd.)

name: NewWork Tokyo The Flagship
card: 95 seats on the 11th floor of Marunouchi Trust Tower N, one minute from Tokyo Station
title: NewWork Tokyo The Flagship — a corporate-membership satellite office on the 11th floor of Marunouchi Trust Tower N, one minute from Tokyo Station
lead: NewWork Tokyo The Flagship is on the 11th floor of Marunouchi Trust Tower N, a one-minute walk from Tokyo Station. It is a large site with 95 open and booth seats, three meeting rooms for 8, a premium meeting room for 6, and wide four-person and single-person private booths. It is a corporate-membership satellite shared office run by Tokyu Corporation. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Tokyu Corporation (corporate membership only; no drop-in)
95 seats (open / booth) / 3 meeting rooms for 8, 1 premium meeting room for 6 / private booths: 2 wide for 4, 20 for 1
concept: The flagship in front of Tokyo Station
“The Flagship” marks this as a flagship location: 95 seats, four meeting rooms and 22 private booths right by Tokyo Station.
The official website describes NewWork as a satellite shared office aiming to support new ways of working, work–life balance, higher productivity and less commuting stress.
steps: There are 95 seats of two kinds: open and booth.
There is a printer, Wi-Fi, power and phone booths.
Three rooms for 8 and a premium room
There are three meeting rooms for 8 and one premium meeting room for 6, all booked in advance.
Close to Tokyo Station, they also work for meetings with outside guests.
Wide booths for 4 and single booths
There are two wide private booths for 4 and twenty for one, all booked in advance.
That is enough to secure a private booth even on days full of online meetings.

word.title: What does “The Flagship” mean?
body: A flagship is the leading ship of a fleet — and, by extension, a company's main store. At NewWork, the sites in the Shibuya Gotoh Ikueikai Building and Shinjuku-sanchome also carry the name.
Tokyo The Flagship is on the 11th floor of Marunouchi Trust Tower N, a one-minute walk from Tokyo Station.

credits: NewWork official website: “NewWork Tokyo The Flagship”
